normalization.method: Restore source aspect ratio from fixed 1280x720 stored coordinate grid before FPPA extraction
normalization.assumption: Dataset processing used VideoProcessor.process_video defaults; per-frame coordinate grid was not persisted
normalization.limitation: Pose estimation already saw a stretched 640x360 image; coordinate restoration does not undo pose-estimator bias
normalization.rejection_reason: MDY source-frame overlay verifies letterboxed stored coordinates. Scaling normalized grid coordinates by native aspect ratio distorts valid geometry. Discard this experiment.
